After: the wrap is mostly left, apparently one half remaining (about 50% of it). Sushi is gone, the fruit is mostly eaten (~15% left), the drink is finished (the glass looks empty/water), and the soy sauce is partly used.

Eaten:
- Wrap: about half, ~150 g, ~275 kcal
- Sushi: 60 g, 90 kcal
- Fruit: ~125 g, 60 kcal
- Cola: ~300 g, 130 kcal (the glass is empty, so it was drunk)
- Soy sauce and ginger: ~15 g, 10 kcal

Total: ~650 g, ~565 kcal. Counting the drink as "food" mass is questionable, but it is included here.
